summary: the largest time step that still resolves the fluid's relaxation time

inputs.name: relaxation_time
inputs.meaning: the relaxation time of the constitutive model

inputs.name: resolved_fraction
inputs.meaning: the fraction of the relaxation time one step may span; a judgement, bound to a row with its own source

outputs.name: time_step_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the time step from the relaxation time

validity: a viscoelastic model integrated in time; for a steady solution reached by time marching the fraction may be large and the bound not the tightest

source.citation: by definition: a step that is a stated fraction of the model's relaxation time
source.locus: the fraction is an input, not a property of this skill

note: Taken from contracts/examples/skills/bound/. On the fixture engine's figures.
